assembly.description: The game's assembly, relative to this folder; {config} is the build's configuration. Left out for a game of data only.

mounts.description: Content folders, relative to this folder, mounted in order; the last wins.

modsDirectory.description: The folder, relative to this one, whose subfolders are mods (each with a mod.json). Default "mods".

disable.description: Engine module ids this game switches off.

add.description: Further assemblies whose modules are added after the game's own.

plugins.description: The engine's simulation plugins this game uses ("sage.physics3d", "sage.gameplay.*"). Left out, all; empty, none.

kits.description: The kits this game is built on, by plugin id: "sage.kits.rpg".

scene.description: The scene record every world starts in.

sage.description: The engine versions this game was made for: "^0.1".

version.description: The game's own version, 1.4.0: what a mod's "gameVersion" is checked against.

compress.description: Whether `sage cook` block-compresses textures (BC1/BC3). Default true.

uncompressed.description: Texture paths inside a mount, with * and ** wildcards, that `sage cook` keeps as exact RGBA (pixel art, UI, fonts).
